rows.evidence: Tiree is also referenced in the song "Western Ocean" by Skipinnish, a traditional Scottish band co-founded by local Tirisdeach (Tiresian) Angus MacPhail.
rows.summary: A reference in a song is not enough, and Skipinnish were not formed on Tiree.

rows.title: Dad's Army
rows.evidence: In the sitcom Dad's Army, broadcast from 1968 to 1977, Private Frazer claims to be from Barra, which he often describes as "a wild and lonely place".
rows.summary: A character claims to be from Barra. The programme was not filmed there.

rows.title: Barra to Barcelona
rows.evidence: Barra is home to a TV production company, Little Day Productions, who produced the documentary Barra to Barcelona, which was broadcast on BBC Alba in 2022 and 2023. Much of their work features Barra and Vatersay.
rows.summary: The sourced sentence says a Barra company produced the documentary. The claim that the work features Barra is marked citation needed.

rows.title: Julie Fowlis
rows.evidence: Fowlis was born and grew up on North Uist, an island in the Outer Hebrides, in a Gaelic-speaking community.
rows.summary: That birth sentence is marked citation needed.

rows.title: Nerina Pallot
rows.evidence: Pallot was born in London and brought up in Jersey by a half-French father and a mother from Prayag, India, together with her sister.
rows.summary: The upbringing sentence is marked citation needed. She was born in London.

rows.title: Bee Gees
rows.evidence: Robin Hugh Gibb was born on 22 December 1949 in Jane Crookall Maternity Home in Douglas, Isle of Man.
rows.summary: The brothers were born on the Isle of Man. The band is not filed there: Robin Gibb's infobox gives his origin as Manchester, and the family left for Australia. Barry, Robin and Maurice are filed individually.

rows.title: Arthur Cormack
rows.evidence: Born 21 April 1965 Portree, Scotland.
rows.summary: The biography says he was born in Portree. The Isle of Skye appears as a category, not in the birth sentence.

rows.title: Ishbel MacAskill
rows.evidence: She was born in Loanhead, near Edinburgh on 14 March 1941, and adopted by Allan MacIver and his wife Christina MacIver; both were natives of Broker, Isle of Lewis.
rows.summary: She was born in Loanhead. The Isle of Lewis sentence is about her adoptive parents.

rows.title: Donald MacQuarrie
rows.evidence: Donald MacQuarrie was a resident of Grulin who became a pupil of piper Raghnall Mac Ailein Òig of Morar during the latter's visits to Eigg in the late 17th century.
rows.summary: The sentence names Eigg as the place his teacher visited. It does not say Grulin is on Eigg.

rows.title: Howlin' Fling
rows.evidence: In July 2014, the first Howlin' Fling Festival took place on Eigg, with Lynch as organiser and performer.
rows.summary: A festival is not a film, artwork or musical work.

rows.title: Sorley MacLean
rows.evidence: The poet Sorley MacLean was born in Osgaig, a small crofting community on the west coast of the island.
rows.summary: Sorley MacLean is a poet. This category is film, artwork and music.

rows.title: The Boggart
rows.evidence: Castle Stalker is the inspiration for Castle Keep in the children's book The Boggart.
rows.summary: The book is inspiration, and books are outside this category.

rows.title: The Wrigley Sisters
rows.evidence: They are twin sisters, born 16 August 1974, who grew up in Orkney, Scotland.
rows.summary: Orkney is the archipelago, not one atlas island.

rows.title: Fiddlers' Bid
rows.evidence: Fiddlers' Bid are a Shetland based instrumental group known for playing contemporary arrangements of traditional Shetland fiddle tunes.
rows.summary: Shetland is the archipelago, not one atlas island.

rows.title: Alffa
rows.evidence: Alffa are a Welsh language blues rock duo from Llanrug in North Wales, formed in 2015.
rows.summary: Llanrug is not an atlas island.

rows.title: Aled Jones
rows.evidence: Aled Jones (born 29 December 1970) is a Welsh singer, actor and radio and television presenter. Born in Bangor, Wales.
rows.summary: The page gives his birthplace as Bangor, which is not an atlas island.
